text:
nina.sales: Handing off Cardinal HealthTech (Enterprise). Closed: Dedicated capacity + Private (VPC). 12-mo term. Procurement has requested an early-renewal review at month 8.
jordan.cs: Thanks Nina. Need technical contact, SSO details, and any compliance notes. Who owns initial infra?
nina.sales: Tech contact is engops@cardinalht.com. Requirements: SAML2 + SCIM, customer KMS, HIPAA DPA in contract (attached to SF-9001). Also want strict audit logs and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
leo.enablement: I'll take enablement. Plan: 3-week onboarding: week0 infra & peering, week1 SSO + SCIM, week2 evals & prompts. Will publish runbook with acceptance criteria.
tara.support: I'll scope support/infrastructure work. Please open a support ticket with CIDRs, KMS ARN, and SAML metadata. I need expected traffic pattern for sizing.
nina.sales: Created ticket SF-9001 and uploaded CIDRs + contract excerpt + initial SAML metadata. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-9001
maya.successops: I'll track account health and renewal signal. Suggest check-ins: twice-weekly during onboarding, move to monthly after go-live. Flagging "early-renewal-review" as potential risk.
jordan.cs: Action items (owners & due dates): 1) leo: onboarding runbook + acceptance checklist (48h) 2) tara: scope SF-9001 with ETA & infra checklist (48h) 3) maya: stub health dashboard + renewal note (72h) 4) nina: share final SAML metadata + SCIM test user (ASAP).
leo.enablement: Starting runbook. Quick snippet for runbook: ```- VPC peering + routes + firewall rules
- KMS access test (encrypt/decrypt)
- Deploy private model container: redwood-enterprise-v1
- Configure SAML + sync SCIM groups
- Run smoke traffic: 3k tokens across 30 concurrent sessions```
tara.support: I pulled SF-9001. Added infra checklist and initial ETA of 5 business days pending KMS ARN and SAML cert. Will update ticket.
nina.sales: Uploaded SAML cert and provided engineering contact (engops@cardinalht.com).
maya.successops: I'll create dashboard tiles for token usage, error rate, and evaluation pass rate. Also drafting the renewal-risk summary with triggers for escalation.
infra-bot: Onboarding-playbook v1.4 applied to account workspace (automated).
jordan.cs: I'll schedule kickoff for Monday and send calendar invite. Keep updates here; ping me for urgent blockers. :calendar:
